spoken_script: Mistral AI raises €3 billion at a valuation above €21 billion. The Series D was co-led by Samsung Electronics, Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity, with participation from investors including Nvidia, BlackRock and ASML. Why it matters: this is the largest private tech equity raise in European history, signalling robust investor appetite for regional AI infrastructure and model development.
